description: This file defines classes and functions for exporting database models and related datasets in the Apache Superset project, including handling of file naming, content serialization, and related dataset export logic.

classes.name: ExportDatabasesCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting database models and their related datasets, including file content generation and export logic.

methods.name: parse_extra
methods.description: Parses a JSON string payload into a dictionary, fixing specific schema issues if present.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for a database model export based on its name and ID.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Generates YAML content for a database model, including handling of extra fields and SSH tunnel info.

methods.name: _export
methods.description: Yields file paths and content generators for the database model and its related datasets.
